corrections: (1) IG-BOND SPECIFICS OVERSTATED: the inaugural investment-grade notes were $800M (not 'a $1B-style lever-up'), priced Nov-2025 ($350M 4.950% due 2031 + $450M 5.600% due 2035), and the stated use of proceeds was to REPAY OUTSTANDING REVOLVER BORROWINGS plus general corporate purposes — NOT a bond 'issued specifically to lever up for repurchase.' Net debt did rise to ~$1.59B and buybacks are real ($535M in Q1-26, $2B in 2025), so 'debt-financed buyback / net-cash cushion gone' is directionally TRUE, but the dossier's specific causal framing (bond raised to fund buyback) is not supported by the offering's use-of-proceeds language. (2) MARGIN FRAMING: 'operating leverage in reverse' is true at the FY-guide level (FY26 EBITDA margin guided to 23.5%+, below 2025), but Q1-26 in-quarter adj-EBITDA margin was ~26.5% ($395M on ~$1.49B revenue) — the 23.5% is a full-year baseline reflecting H2 investment, not the realized quarterly run-rate. (3) Note FY26 guidance was RAISED on adj-EBITDA / adj-EPS / FCF (rev >=$6.405B, EBITDA >=$1.545B, adj-EPS >=$13.25, FCF >=$1.16B), so the 'EPS purely manufactured by buyback' line is partly blunted — organic EBITDA/FCF guidance also moved up, though CV (the franchise metric) did not.
